intake.description: Following neighbor's excavation work using heavy machinery starting October 20, 2026, the claimant noticed long cracks in two living room walls and the compound wall, along with a door alignment issue on October 26, 2026. A contractor estimated repairs at Rs 75,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-60978 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: The exclusions in this section apply to every part of PROP-COV-2 unless a clause says otherwise.
We do not pay for damage that happens gradually

coverage.reasoning: The claimant experienced cracks in the living room walls and compound wall following excavation work by a neighbor. Under policy exclusion PROP-EXC-4.1, damage that happens gradually is explicitly excluded from coverage. Since the policy excludes gradual damage for all parts of PROP-COV-2 per PROP-EXC-4, this claim is not covered.

reasons: all citations verified against the clause text; outputs passed validation first time
